sources.title: GitHub - studio-dots-ai/dots3-note-prev: dots3 note preview
sources.snippet: Model Introduction dots3-note preview is the first open-weight model in the dots3 family. It is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 280B total parameters, 16B activated parameters, and support for a context length of up to 512K tokens. The model can understand text, images, video, and audio, and produces text outputs.

sources.title: dots3-note Preview - studio.dots.ai
sources.snippet: In dots3-note Preview, we began by building a multimodal foundation capable of understanding text, images, and audio. We then strengthened the model's reasoning and problem-solving abilities on closed, verifiable tasks. Across multiple benchmarks, it matches or even surpasses models several times its size.

sources.snippet: The dots3 family is designed to include models with different trade-offs among capability, latency, and inference cost. dots3-note preview is the most lightweight member of the family.
